name: Attio
desc: Modern, collaborative CRM platform built to be fully customizable and real-time.

actions.name: create_record
actions.description: Creates a new record such as peron,company or deal.

actions.name: update_record
actions.description: Update an existing record with new attribute values.

actions.name: find_record
actions.description: Search for records in Attio using filters and return matching results.

actions.name: get_record
actions.description: Retrieve a single record by ID and return its normalized attribute values.

actions.name: create_entry
actions.description: Add a record to a specified list.

actions.name: update_entry
actions.description: Update the attributes of an existing entry in a list.

actions.name: find_list_entry
actions.description: Search for entries in a specific list in Attio using filters and return matching results.

actions.name: create_note
actions.description: Creates a new note on a record.

actions.name: get_call_transcript
actions.description: Fetches the full transcript for a given call recording.

actions.name: create_task
actions.description: Create a new task in Attio, optionally linked to a record and assigned to a member.

actions.name: list_tasks
actions.description: List tasks with optional filters by linked record, assignee, or completion status.

actions.name: get_task
actions.description: Fetch a single task by its ID.

actions.name: delete_task
actions.description: Permanently delete a task by its ID.

actions.name: update_task
actions.description: Update an existing task in Attio.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: record_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new record such as person,company or deal is created.

triggers.name: record_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing record is updated (people, companies, deals, etc.).

triggers.name: list_entry_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new entry is added.

triggers.name: list_entry_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing entry is updated.

triggers.name: call_recording_created
triggers.description: Triggers when a call recording finishes and its media upload is complete.
